Woman dies from burn injuries after candle mishap during power outage

A differently-abled woman in Kerala has died from burn injuries sustained when a candle she was using during a power cut ignited her clothes. The incident occurred in Kochi, highlighting the dangers associated with alternative lighting methods during electricity disruptions. This event underscores the risks faced by vulnerable individuals during power outages.
